# Build: refresh-token-save (pending id first-refresh-token-saved-every-time-it-s-used-v)

Brett said (verbatim): "I'm going to log in as Moses X. You need to save it, and the very first build is to make the refresh token update every time it's used."

Target: ~20 minutes. Do ONLY this, nothing else.

The VPS Claude login is now mossesx@gmail.com (/root/.claude/.credentials.json). Whenever that login (or any saved account in /root/.claude-accounts or the ai-keys plugin store) uses or renews its OAuth refresh token, write the rotated refresh + access token back to the saved copy immediately, so the next run never uses a dead token. Check the ai-keys renew thread (apps/console-web/plugins/ai-keys), deploy/claude-headless.sh launches, and the account switch path.

Don't load the full CLAUDE.md chain; read only the files you need. Small test with fake tokens. Commit on this branch, open a PR, do not land. Tick step 17 of pending item token-usage-log-accounts-plan-studio-control and mark pending item first-refresh-token-saved-every-time-it-s-used-v complete when done.
